evidence.ACL: The contour of ACL is not in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside on F/S T2WI, in favor of tear.
evidence.MCL: Interstitial increseased signal intensity of MCL on F/S T2WI, in favor of grade 1 injury.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: No evidence of tear is noted in either medial or lateral meniscus.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: No evidence of tear is noted in either medial or lateral meniscus.
evidence.Synovitis: hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
evidence.Baker's: mild infrapatellar bursitis and Baker's cyst.
evidence.Contusion: Abnormal signal intensity is noted in proximal tibia and distal femur, which shows low signal intensity on T1WI and high signal intensity on T2WI, in favor of bone contusion.
evidence.Fracture: Suspicious of subchondral fracture of lateral femoral condyle.
